job: Show code a developer will read or paste, with copy, line numbers and language tabs.
purpose: A framed block on a sunken well with a header and a pre. Fire tokenises JSON, shell and cURL, JavaScript and TypeScript, and Python; unknown text stays plain. The header holds a filename or language tabs, never both. Options: line numbers, a highlighted range, a folded height, soft wrap. Copy takes the raw text.
useWhen: A request, a config or a response is shown in docs or a detail panel.
The same request is offered in several languages: use tabs; the choice syncs across the page.
A long response should start folded with a "Show all" button.

avoidWhen.when: One command or one value to copy.
A response people explore and fold.
Streaming lines with levels and search.

states.name: copied
states.how: data-state="copied" for 1.4s after copy; the icon becomes a check and "Copied"

states.name: collapsed
states.how: data-collapse="240" folds to that height in px; data-expanded when open

states.name: wrapped
states.how: data-wrap; toggled by the wrap button

variants.useWhen: On the tab list: tiny segmented tabs for a header that carries a label.
Show line numbers; the gutter stays put while code scrolls.
On a line: the highlighted line bar.
Fold to a pixel height with a Show all button.

parts.role: The file name with an icon.
A toggle button such as wrap.
The pre that holds the code.
The fade and button of a folded block.

keyboard.does: Move between language tabs and select.
Jump to the first or last tab.
On copy or wrap, activates it.
